shape_hint: Plain hexagon head with a flat top and flat underside, no washer face or flange. Below it a fully threaded tapping-screw shank (thread runs right up to the head, a = P) ending in a cone point (Type C) or a short flat/truncated point (Type F). Draw head height k, width across flats s (side view s, top view hexagon with e across corners), and point length y.

notes: Edition: DIN 7976 / ISO 1479:1983 (type C and F). verification.checks_done: Re-fetched live 7 listed URLs (all HTTP 200) + gf detail_5230 (producer copy). Parsed all tables with tbl.py; built matrix 9 rows x 10 data cols x 8 parsed pages (torqbolt, vidasan, gf541, gf5230, aya, westfield, nfgab k/s/e rows, wegert k/s/y rows) and counted agreeing clusters per cell. Result: P,e_min,k,k_min,k_max,r_max,s_max,s_min,yC_max >=3 clusters in all 9 rows (P, k_min, k_max, r_max, s_min exactly 3 = A,B,C); yF_max only 2 clusters (A,B) in every row (westfield lists Type C only, nfgab/wegert have no yF, aya yF is mirror of gf). Semantics read from headers (P, e min, k nominal/min/max, r max, s max=nominal/min, y max Type C/Type F). Sanity: e_min = 1.12*s_min (+-0.01), s_max<e<1.1547*s_min, k_min<k<k_max, monotone; all pass. fasteners.eu not fetchable (HTTP 466) - not counted.
problems: yF_max (y max Type F): only clusters A (torqbolt/vidasan) and B (gf, aya = gf 5230 mirror) list it -> 2 clusters; ST3.9 row has only torqbolt+vidasan+gf; ST8 only torqbolt+gf+aya. DROP column.

ayafasteners.com is NOT independent of globalfastener.com: its ISO 1479:2011 table has the same row order/labels and identical values as gf detail_5230 (incl. ST9.5 and '/' cells) -> producer counted it as a separate source for P, e, s, y.

torqbolt and vidasan appear to share one origin (same 5.95 for ST3.5 e_min, same label wording) -> counted as one cluster; with this merge k_min, k_max, r_max, s_min, P are supported by exactly 3 clusters (A torqbolt/vidasan, B gf, C westfield).

ST3.5 e_min=5.96 is contested: 5.96 in gf, aya(=gf), westfield, nfgab (3 independent clusters) vs 5.95 in torqbolt+vidasan; 1.12*5.32=5.958 favours 5.96. Passes the >=3 rule but is the weakest e cell.
ST4.8 yC_max: wegertseder group prints 4.2 (typo) vs 4.3 in 5 other pages -> 4.3 ok.

Edition: k_min/k_max/r_max exist only for the DIN 7976 / ISO 1479:1983 edition (torqbolt/vidasan, gf541, westfield); ISO 1479:2011 values differ (aya, gf5230, nfgab k ISO) - record correctly uses 1983 edition, state this in the standard note.
